d: Listen to this timeless evergreen classic Hindi song 'Jab Jab Bahar Aaye' sung by the legend Mohammed Rafi from the Bollywood blockbuster superhit black & white family drama movie 'Taqdeer' (1967), starring Bharat Bhushan, Shalini, Farida Jalal, Johnny Walker, Kamal Kapoor, Jalal Agha. Directed by A Salaam. Music composed by Laxmikant-Pyarelal. Lyrics by Anand Bakshi.
